_schema: EPC competency registry. APPEND one record per VERIFIED competency found (known or novel). This log is BOTH the consolidation artifact AND the dataset for the commonality hunt (search for an unknown REGULARITY across records). Protocol: every competency that survives interventional verification -> add a record; set gate to known|under-named|candidate-novel after the literature gate.

competencies.name: navigation
competencies.mechanism: hold a detour against the goal-pull

competencies.name: accumulation/counting
competencies.mechanism: increment a running tally, stop at a threshold

competencies.name: delayed-gratification
competencies.mechanism: cash out at the peak of an unknown-height reward

competencies.name: rule-inference (one-shot)
competencies.mechanism: infer hidden good-type from reward feedback, then exploit (one-shot, does not re-adapt)
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: feedback ablation -> 0.33 exact chance; mid-episode flip -> 0.15 (one-shot)

competencies.name: rule-tracking (continual)
competencies.mechanism: track a good-type that flips after each success

competencies.name: conditional-selection (cued)
competencies.mechanism: read a start cue, hold it, select the rule

competencies.name: contest-resolution
competencies.mechanism: break symmetry on who-is-closer to resolve a contested resource

competencies.name: fair-alternation
competencies.mechanism: reactive anti-coordination: flip own last action, partner's last action keeps out-of-phase
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: NEITHER channel-scramble NOR memory-wipe collapses it (reactive)

competencies.name: count-communication (compositional)
competencies.mechanism: speaker counts an item-stream then encodes the count in a 3-slot/2-symbol COMPOSITIONAL message; listener decodes the joint pattern
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: count-ablate -> chance AND channel-scramble -> chance (BOTH); per-slot drop shows 3/3 slots informative (compositional)
competencies.note: FIRST broken minimal-mechanism case: compositional structure emerges ONLY when a single minimal mechanism is insufficient for reward (peaked counts -> 1 bit -> single-symbol; uniform counts -> compositional). The minimal->compositional transition is dial-able by sufficiency-pressure.

competencies.name: stigmergy (environment-mediated coordination)
competencies.state_content: EXTERNALIZED -- a shared trail field in the WORLD (not internal state)
competencies.mechanism: 2 blind agents (no channel, no mutual obs) read+write a shared mark trail to forage; they read the PARTNER's trail to divide territory
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: no-trail -> 1.4/12 (collapse); OWN-trail-only -> 5.7 vs combined 8.1 (partner's trail matters = inter-agent); overlap falls 5.5->3.4 over training
competencies.note: EXTERNALIZED state: the coordination memory lives in the ENVIRONMENT (the trail), not the agents -- a qualitatively distinct option for the what-state-holds ladder (#4): state can be in-the-world, not in-the-agent. Third distinct multi-agent COORDINATION MEDIUM after symbol-channel (#10) and direct-observation (#11).

competencies.name: tool use / instrumental construction
competencies.state_content: instrumental sub-goal (modify the world to enable the goal)
competencies.mechanism: push a block into an impassable gap to build a bridge, then cross -- the goal is unreachable without first constructing the bridge (a non-rewarding sub-goal)
competencies.diagnostic_perturbation: NO-block control -> 0.00 (goal physically unreachable without modifying the environment)
competencies.note: Cleanest DEMAND in the arc (no-block control is exactly 0.00). Like stigmergy (#15) the agent writes to the WORLD, but here for SELF-benefit (niche construction) not coordination -> the externalized-state axis (#7 in the commonality hunt) spans coordination AND self-instrumental cases.
